title: Covert Mode Is a Page Navigation, Not a Toggle
symptom_md: On the Engineer's Report, pressing the covert button navigates to /analysis/{id}/view/C (full page load) instead of toggling. User loses scroll position. On non-results pages, the same button does a client-side class toggle.
hypothesis_md: Results page requires server-rendered covert template, so navigation is architecturally necessary. Scroll position loss and inconsistent interaction pattern were unaddressed.
root_cause_md: activateCovertOrSwitch() uses location.href navigation on analysis pages with no scroll preservation. Fixed by adding sessionStorage save/restore of scrollY.

title: Glass Treatment Only on Posture Cards
symptom_md: Glassmorphism CSS selectors only match cards with exact class combination card.border-{status}.bg-{status}.bg-opacity-10. Confidence and Currency cards use card.bg-dark and get no glass treatment or hover-lift.
hypothesis_md: CSS selectors were written for the first card type and never extended to other card patterns.
root_cause_md: Missing .card.bg-dark glass treatment rule. Fixed by adding glassmorphism and hover-lift to .card.bg-dark selector.

title: Golden Ratio Claim Scope Verification
symptom_md: Topology SVG claims golden ratio (320/198 = 1.616 ≈ phi) which is mathematically accurate. CSS type scale uses ad hoc values not derived from phi.
hypothesis_md: Claim may have been broader than implementation.
root_cause_md: Verified: claim is correctly scoped to topology SVG aria-description only. No system-wide golden ratio claim found in user-facing code.

title: No prefers-reduced-motion in CSS
symptom_md: Users who set Reduce Motion in OS settings still see every CSS transition, transform, and animation. JavaScript handles topology SVG SMIL but CSS transitions are unprotected.
root_cause_md: Missing @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block. Fixed by adding universal selector that kills animation-duration and transition-duration.

title: Stats Metric Label 2.1:1 Contrast Ratio
symptom_md: .stats-confidence-metric-label uses color #484f58 on #161b22 background. Contrast ratio approximately 2.1:1. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text.
root_cause_md: Hardcoded color too dark. Fixed by changing to #8b949e (5.1:1 contrast ratio).

title: Compare Select Rows Keyboard Inaccessible
symptom_md: Domain comparison rows use click handlers on bare tr elements. No tabindex, no role, no aria-label. Keyboard-only users cannot reach or activate these rows.
root_cause_md: Missing keyboard accessibility attributes. Fixed by adding tabindex=0, role=button, aria-label, and Enter/Space keydown handler.

title: Architecture Page SVG Diagrams 404
symptom_md: Two SVG diagrams (drift-notification-pipeline.svg and github-issues-triage.svg) reported as returning 404 on the architecture page.
hypothesis_md: Files may have been missing from static/images/diagrams/ directory.
root_cause_md: Files exist and serve HTTP 200. Issue was previously resolved.

title: Copy Buttons Mouse-Only Visibility
symptom_md: .copy-btn has opacity: 0 by default and only becomes visible on :hover. Keyboard-only users never see the button and cannot focus on an invisible element.
root_cause_md: Missing keyboard focus reveal. Fixed by adding :focus-within and :focus selectors alongside :hover for opacity:1.

title: Anchor Scroll Handler Hijacks Bootstrap Collapse
symptom_md: A generic smooth-scroll handler on ALL a[href^="#"] links calls e.preventDefault(), blocking Bootstrap collapse triggers that use href="#target" instead of data-bs-target.
hypothesis_md: Bootstrap collapse relies on default click behavior which is being intercepted.

title: white-space-nowrap Class Does Not Exist
symptom_md: Template uses CSS class white-space-nowrap which does not exist in Bootstrap or custom CSS. The intended class is text-nowrap.

title: border-accent-gold-muted Class Does Not Exist
symptom_md: Currency card references border-accent-gold-muted as a CSS class. No CSS rule exists for this class. Border color falls back to default.

title: DNS Hosting Column Missing text-truncate
symptom_md: In Domain Summary, Registrar/Email/Web Hosting columns use text-truncate. DNS Hosting column does not. Long provider names overflow on mobile.

title: Chevron Icons Never Rotate on Collapse
symptom_md: Chevron-down icons remain pointing down regardless of panel state. Users get no visual feedback about whether a section is open or closed.
hypothesis_md: Missing CSS transform or JS toggle for chevron rotation on Bootstrap collapse events.

title: Tooltips Only Work on Results Pages
symptom_md: Bootstrap tooltip initialization happens only in inline script inside results.html. Global main.js has no tooltip init. Tooltips on other pages do nothing.

title: Mobile Navbar Menu Extends Below Viewport
symptom_md: Navbar collapse dropdown uses position: absolute with no max-height and no overflow-y: auto. With 11+ nav items on shorter mobile screens, menu extends below viewport.

title: Footer Wall of Text at 375px
symptom_md: Ten or more footer links in a single p tag separated by middot dots. At 375px this renders as unstructured wall of text with no grouping.

title: Video Category Score F (57/100)
symptom_md: SquirrelScan video category scored 57/100. Likely missing VideoObject structured data, accessibility attributes, poster images, or proper preload configuration.
hypothesis_md: Multiple video optimization best practices not implemented.

title: OAuth Client ID Exposed in Page Source
symptom_md: Google OAuth Client ID visible in inline script on login page. Google documents client IDs as not secret and exposed to resource owners.
hypothesis_md: Standard OAuth2 flow requires client_id in browser. This is hygiene, not a vulnerability.

title: Sanity Token Exposed in HTML
symptom_md: A Sanity Token exposed in analysis view HTML. Sanity documents tokens as credentials that should generally be considered secret. Browser-exposed tokens are a bad idea.
hypothesis_md: Token may be a read-only public dataset token, but exposure should be verified and scoped.

title: CSP script-src Allows Wildcard
symptom_md: The script-src directive uses *, allowing JavaScript execution from any origin. This effectively disables browser-side XSS defense.

title: 908 !important Declarations
symptom_md: ~908 !important declarations, ~450 in covert mode alone. Architecturally inevitable without CSS @layer. Every future style must also use !important.
hypothesis_md: CSS @layer would resolve the specificity arms race. Supported since March 2022.

title: 50+ Hardcoded Hex Colors Outside Token System
symptom_md: Documented 5-layer color architecture with CSS custom properties exists. But 50+ hex values bypass it entirely.

title: Blur Radius Has 4 Values No Design Token
symptom_md: backdrop-filter uses 12px, 8px, 6px, 4px across components with no documented rationale. No --blur-* design tokens.

title: 5+ Transition Timing Values No System
symptom_md: 0.15s, 0.2s, 0.25s, 0.3s, 0.35s — five different transition speeds across interactive elements. No transition design tokens.

title: transition: all Animates Every CSS Property
symptom_md: transition: all 0.2s ease animates width, height, box-shadow, and layout-triggering properties causing unnecessary GPU work.

title: Three Syntaxes for Same Breakpoint
symptom_md: Mixes max-width: 767px, 767.98px, and 768px — three different expressions for the same mobile/tablet boundary.

title: Print CSS Scattered Across 4 Locations
symptom_md: Dedicated print.css plus 3 @media print blocks in custom.css plus inline style in results_executive.html. Four sources of truth.

title: Covert Mode Missed .u-code-block and .icae-card
symptom_md: .code-block has covert mode overrides. .u-code-block does not. ICAE card with gold gradient border has no covert override either.

title: Font Units Mixed rem px pt in Non-Print CSS
symptom_md: Non-print CSS mixes rem, px, and pt. px and pt values will not scale with user font size preferences.

title: Two Code Block Implementations
symptom_md: .code-block has copy button, hover effects, covert mode overrides. .u-code-block has none. Both exist. Templates may use either.

title: 66+ Pages Missing Canonical URLs
symptom_md: /topology, /compare, and 66+ dynamic pages lack <link rel=canonical>. Search engines may index multiple URLs for same content.

title: Charset Not First Element in head
symptom_md: meta charset=UTF-8 must be within the first 1024 bytes and should be first child of head. Currently not first.

title: External Links Returning 403/404
symptom_md: Four external links broken: two DTIC military research PDFs (403), IANA RDAP reference (404), DNI ICD 203 PDF (404).
hypothesis_md: External resources may have moved or been access-restricted.

title: 15 Duplicate Page Titles Across 43 Pages
symptom_md: History pagination pages share identical titles. Analysis view and analyze pages share titles. Search engines treat as duplicate content.

title: Domain Input Missing required Attribute
symptom_md: Main domain input field lacks HTML required attribute. Form can be submitted empty.

title: Search Hint Not Linked via aria-describedby
symptom_md: Helper text below search input is not connected to the input via aria-describedby. Screen readers cannot associate the hint.

title: Recon Mode Button Icon Only on Mobile
symptom_md: Recon Mode button shows only an icon at small breakpoints with no visible text label or accessible name providing context.

title: ROE Script Tags Look Clickable But Are Not
symptom_md: Rules of Engagement page script tags appear visually interactive but have no click handler or keyboard interaction.

title: TLP Dropdown Items Missing role Attribute
symptom_md: TLP dropdown items use href=# without role attribute. Assistive technology cannot determine the interactive nature of these elements.

title: No Active Nav State on Analysis Pages
symptom_md: When viewing analysis results, no navigation item shows active/current state. Users lose location context within the site.

title: 7 Header Action Buttons Compress at 375px
symptom_md: Seven header action buttons in results view compress and overlap at 375px mobile width. Buttons become hard to tap.

title: Accordion Focus Styles Invisible on Dark Background
symptom_md: Default browser focus outline is invisible on dark background. Accordion items show no visible focus indicator when navigating by keyboard.

title: Skip Link Uses :focus Instead of :focus-visible
symptom_md: Skip-to-content link uses :focus instead of :focus-visible. Shows focus ring on mouse click in some browsers, not just keyboard navigation.

title: No @supports Fallback for backdrop-filter
symptom_md: Browsers without backdrop-filter support render semi-transparent backgrounds without blur. Text over complex backgrounds becomes unreadable.

title: TTL Tuner Promo Card Overflow at 375px
symptom_md: TTL Tuner promotional card content overflows its container at 375px mobile width.

title: Footer Orphan Link to Nonexistent Page
symptom_md: Footer contains a link to a page that returns 404. Broken internal link in global footer affects every page.
